title: The biggest spiritual flex is realizing you don’t have to attend every argument you’re invited to. 🚫🤡
paragraphs: The biggest spiritual flex is realizing you don’t have to attend every argument you’re invited to. 🚫🤡

When you know who you fight FOR, you stop fighting WITH foolishness. The enemy sends distractions; God sends peace. Elevate above the noise. Your assignment is too important to be engaged with the circus. 🌿✨
📖 “Don’t have anything to do with foolish and stupid arguments, because you know they produce quarrels.” — 2 Timothy 2:23 (NIV)
Are you ready to protect your peace?
